_comment: v1 SAR change detection (AGENTS.md §9, Phase 7a): explainable, no learned model.
Both dates are Lee-filtered, the log-ratio of backscatter is taken in dB, Otsu's threshold on
|delta| is applied with a floor, and connected regions above a minimum area are flagged.
Values are modelled defaults, checked on synthetic speckle in the tests; a change bumps version.
